title: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
text: Amazon said that the feature will roll out to millions of users in coming weeks.

title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
text: Despite its small size, Underdog's new model can generate both speech and music.

title: Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots
text: Physicl is trying to solve the sim-to-real gap with a pipeline originally built to market goods online.

title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
text: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.

title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
text: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.

title: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
text: Cult.fit is using Codex to help teams across functions build tools, move faster, and change how work gets done.

title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
text: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
text: Meta warns that growing political opposition to data centers could threaten future AI investments, as communities push back against massive infrastructure projects.

title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
text: OpenAI's newest cybersecurity model comes out as AI labs face scrutiny of their work to protect digital infrastructure.

title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
text: Speaking at a Wall Street Journal tech conference on Wednesday, the executive touted how the company had been gaining ground in the enterprise market, where rival Anthropic had already successfully made inroads.

title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
text: With Personal Finance in Claude, users can connect their bank and card accounts through Plaid and ask questions about their finances.

title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
text: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
text: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash brings native 15-second video generation and editing, stronger consistency, and 30% lower pricing.

title: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
text: As AI floods math with unchecked proofs, Axiom Math is betting on verification. The startup’s AI agents just formally verified the Stacks Project, one of the field’s biggest libraries.

title: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
text: The deal is expected to support the development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at developers building AI models and agents.

title: Aina’s smart ring has a screen, a joystick, and a mic so you can talk to AI agents
text: Aina's ring can also take calls and help you dictate notes on your Mac.

title: Box taps Nvidia’s Nemotron for new agent-first content retrieval system
text: The system can supposedly answer queries four times faster, with 20% fewer errors and 90% fewer tokens used.

title: A YC startup is putting $1M behind 5 unsolved materials science problems for AI
text: While frontier AI models have solved a remarkable series of outstanding mathematics problems and made progress in the life sciences, they have yet to truly plumb the complex physics in advanced materials.
